name: Satomi Toshiaki
source: [url=/c11390]Makoto's[/url] father. [url=/c11393]Kiyora[/url] tells him that she is dressing Makoto as a girl to attract visitors to the shrine so he knows from the start. He's very excited that his son has begun to dress as a girl because he always wanted a daughter. Tries to set Makoto up with boys to marry so he can have a son-in-law.
